lines.en: label dormwarssixniki1:
scene nikimeetup1
: There are people here, though. Hello. I brought the daughter you never wanted and her friend who intends to fight you for my hand in marriage.
lines.zh: : 不过这儿有人呢。你们好。我把你从来都不想要的那个女儿带来了，还带来她那个打算为了娶我而跟你打一架的朋友。

lines.en: : As if I’d ever fucking marry you, asshole! Who gave you permission to speak to me?! You’re still in timeout!
lines.zh: : 我他妈才不会嫁给你呢，混蛋！谁允许你跟我说话了？！你还在罚站呢！

lines.en: : Damn, girl. Ain’t you supposed to be in love with him? Let me take him off your hands if you hate him that much.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，姐妹。你不是应该爱着他吗？既然你这么烦他，不如让给我好了。

lines.en: : No one gets to throw away my trash but me! Fuck off, NDA lady!
lines.zh: : 我的垃圾只有我本人能扔！滚开，保密协议大姐！

lines.en: : Nee-chan, I brought the compress and water you-
lines.zh: : 姐姐，我把你要的冰袋和水带——

lines.en: scene nikimeetup2
: Oh, good! Thank you, Noriko! And here I was worried I was going to have to come look for you and find you ruining even {i}more{/i} of my childhood dreams!
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了！谢谢你，Noriko！我刚才还担心得要命，怕我得亲自去找你，然后撞见你又在毁掉我{i}更{/i}多的童年梦想！

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I found Ami so she wouldn’t be able to sabotage anything this time.
lines.zh: : 别担心。我找到 Ami 了，所以这次她没法再搞破坏了。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup1
: Again! Do not speak unless spoken to! How many times do I have to tell you that?!
lines.zh: : 又来了！没跟你说话就不许开口！这话我得说多少遍？！

lines.en: scene nikimeetup3
: Niki’s a little different than I expected.
lines.zh: : Niki 跟我想的不太一样。

lines.en: : Noriko got all of the kindness in that family. Niki makes up for it in unadulterated rage.
lines.zh: : 那家人的温柔全给了 Noriko。Niki 则用纯粹的暴怒把这份缺口补上了。

lines.en: : Maybe I’m just misreading the room, but I don’t think you should be referencing any form of adultery in the same sentence as Niki for a while.
lines.zh: : 也许是我会错意了，不过我觉得你这阵子最好别把任何形式的「出轨」跟 Niki 放在同一句话里说。

lines.en: : Are you absolutely sure she’s in the running? I know {i}I’d{/i} never yell at you like that.
lines.zh: : 你真的确定她也在竞争之列？我就知道，{i}我{/i}绝对不会像她那样冲你吼。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup4
: You should try. I might actually like it.
lines.zh: : 你可以试试。我说不定还真会喜欢。

lines.en: : Oh, cool. I guess I’ll keep that in mind then.
lines.zh: : 哦，酷。那我就记在心里了。

lines.en: : Can I yell at you too, Dad?
lines.zh: : 那我也能冲你吼吗，爸爸？

lines.en: scene nikimeetup5
: No. Every time you yell at me, I just get sad.
lines.zh: : 不行。你每次冲我吼，我只会难过。

lines.en: : Aww. That just means you love me.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。那正说明你爱我嘛。

lines.en: : And here I was thinking it made me a bad parent.
lines.zh: : 我还以为那说明我不是个好家长呢。

lines.en: : You {i}are{/i} a bad parent! And you’re an even worse boyfriend! Now get on your knees and-
lines.zh: : 你{i}就是{/i}个糟糕的家长！更是个糟糕透顶的男朋友！现在给我跪下然后——

lines.en: : Nee-chan, you {i}do{/i} know you’re going ballistic in front of a ton of admirers, right?
lines.zh: : 姐姐，你{i}知道{/i}自己正在一堆仰慕者面前发疯吧？

lines.en: scene nikimeetup6
: Hahah! Yay! Fans!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！好耶！粉丝！

lines.en: scene nikimeetup7
: That was all just acting, of course. I’m actually practicing for a new drama I’ll be appearing in soon and my childhood friend over there has been helping me run lines.
lines.zh: : 当然，刚才那些都是演的。其实我是在练一部新剧的台词，我很快就要出演了，那边那位青梅竹马一直在帮我对词。

lines.en: : A last ditch effort to salvage her career after intentionally blowing it up.
lines.zh: : 在亲手把自己的事业炸掉之后，为了挽救它而做的最后挣扎。

lines.en: : How about I intentionally blow your head off next, Noriko? That sure sounds fun, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那接下来我故意把你的头轰掉怎么样，Noriko？听起来挺有意思的，对吧？

lines.en: : A drama? I didn’t know you could act too.
lines.zh: : 演戏？我不知道你还会演戏。

lines.en: : All part of the job. And natural progression for a star like me. It’s definitely not because I’m expecting to be hit with a massive lawsuit and need the money or anything.
lines.zh: : 都是工作的一部分。对我这种明星来说也是很自然的转型。绝对不是因为我预料到自己会被一桩巨额诉讼找上门、急需用钱什么的。

lines.en: : It feels kind of surreal seeing you like this. So you and Sensei have really known each other since you were kids?
lines.zh: : 看到你这个样子感觉有点不真实。所以你和 Sensei 真的是从小认识的？

lines.en: scene nikimeetup8
: Sure have. Had our first kiss in my house and everything. Noriko can vouch for that. Can’t you, Noriko?
lines.zh: : 没错。初吻都是在我家呢，该有的都有了。Noriko 可以作证。对吧，Noriko？

lines.en: : I was either not alive or not coherent yet when that happened. I have no idea. I’m sure it’s the truth, though.
lines.zh: : 那会儿我要么还没出生，要么还不懂事。我什么都不知道。不过我相信她说的是真的。

lines.en: : Aren’t you worried that...people might see you here and...get the wrong idea?
lines.zh: : 你就不担心……有人在这儿看到你，然后……误会什么吗？

lines.en: : Zagull Throat Spear is right. We could be in the early stages of a brand {i}new{/i} scandal right now.
lines.zh: : Zagull Throat Spear 说得对。我们现在说不定正处在一条全{i}新{/i}丑闻的萌芽阶段。

lines.en: : Interesting name. And no, I’m not worried.
lines.zh: : 名字挺有意思。不，我不担心。

lines.en: : For in rearranging my priorities, I’ve decided that I’m now going to be involved in all of your lives as well simply because I know it will make life harder for the Arakawas and that is now my mission on this earth.
lines.zh: : 因为在重新排过优先级之后，我决定接下来也要介入你们所有人的生活——原因很简单，我知道这会让 Arakawa 家的人日子更难过，而这现在就是我在这个世上的使命。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup9
: Wait. What do you mean “more involved?” I thought you were just making a guest appearance in the Dorm Wars to mess with Onii-chan?
lines.zh: : 等等。你说的「介入」是什么意思？我以为你只是在宿舍大战里客串一下，来找哥哥麻烦的？

lines.en: : Right now, that’s what I’m doing. But who’s to say that I won’t be your new teacher tomorrow?
lines.zh: : 眼下我是在做这个。可谁说得准呢，说不定明天我就成了你们的新老师？

lines.en: : Me. And trust me, you don’t want to teach them anyway.
lines.zh: : 我说了算。而且相信我，你根本不会想教她们的。

lines.en: : She has a point. We are quite the motley crew when push comes to shove.
lines.zh: : 她说得有道理。真逼到份上，我们这帮人可是相当乌合之众。

lines.en: : Either way, I’ll be damned if I’m going to be excluded from anything from here on out. And being around all of you is the best way to keep an eye on Akira that I can think of.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，从今往后我绝不允许自己被排除在任何事之外。而待在你们身边，是我想得到的盯住 Akira 的最好办法。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup10
: Oh hey, yeah. Maybe I should start doing that too then? A little more time together wouldn’t hurt.
lines.zh: : 哦对啊，说的是。那也许我也该开始这么做了？多待在一起也没什么坏处。

lines.en: : No, it certainly wouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 是啊，确实没坏处。

lines.en: : Nee-chan! You can’t just insert yourself into my class like that!
lines.zh: : 姐姐！你不能就这么硬插进我们班来！

lines.en: : Why not when Akira’s allowed to insert himself wherever he likes? Both literally and figuratively.
lines.zh: : 凭什么不行？Akira 不也爱插到哪儿就插到哪儿吗？字面意义和引申义都是。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup11
: {i}Watch it. Y’all have come damn close to confirming a bunch of shit that {i}shouldn’t{/i} be confirmed around me today.
lines.zh: : 注意点。你们今天差点就把一堆{i}不该{/i}在我面前坐实的事情给坐实了。

lines.en: : Onii-chan’s not legally bound to Nakayama Sister Law! Cozying up to my friends is a clear violation of Section 3, Subsection B-4, Sub-Subsection S9-571, Amendment 8!
lines.zh: : 哥哥可不受《中山姐妹法》约束！跟我朋友套近乎，明显违反了第 3 条 B-4 款 S9-571 子款，第 8 修正案！

lines.en: : Uh...what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么？

lines.en: : The fact that you even have the balls to speak to me about Sister Law after what you did tells me all I need to know about your legal interests, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 你做了那些事之后，居然还有脸跟我谈什么姐妹法，光这一点就足够让我看清你的法律立场了，Noriko。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup12
: The rest of us will be great friends, though! So long as none of you get in the way of any of my interests. Got it?
lines.zh: : 不过我们其他人会成为很好的朋友！只要你们谁都别碍着我的任何利益。明白了吗？

lines.en: : She’s a lot spicier than you made her sound, Noriko. I like it.
lines.zh: : 她可比你说得带劲多了，Noriko。我喜欢。

lines.en: : Well, I {i}don’t.{/i} This is overstepping even {i}if{/i} she’s just trying to get back at me right now.
lines.zh: : 我{i}可不喜欢{/i}。{i}就算{/i}她现在只是想报复我，这也太过分了。

lines.en: : Why don’t you overstep the ledge of the highest building you can find, my precious little sister? Meanwhile, I’ll stay here and make everyone who loves you love {i}me{/i} even more.
lines.zh: : 那你为什么不从你能找到的最高的楼上跨出去呢，我宝贵的妹妹？与此同时，我会留在这儿，让所有爱你的人更爱{i}我{/i}一点。

lines.en: : That might work on Otoha, but it won’t work on Kirin or Yumi or anybody else.
lines.zh: : 这招对 Otoha 可能有用，但对 Kirin、Yumi 或者别的什么人都没用。

lines.en: : To be completely honest, I already like your sister more.
lines.zh: : 老实说，我已经更喜欢你姐姐了。

lines.en: : One down, a fucking {i}thousand{/i} or whatever to go. There are {i}so{/i} fucking many of you! But what’s most annoying is how fucking {i}cute{/i} all of you are! Hahahaha! AWESOME!
lines.zh: : 搞定一个，还有他妈的{i}一千{/i}个之类的要搞定。你们他妈的怎么{i}这么{/i}多！但最气人的是，你们怎么一个个都他妈这么{i}可爱{/i}！哈哈哈哈！太棒了！

lines.en: scene nikimeetup13
: Do I need to tell you not to take that the wrong way? Or have you learned how to behave yet?
lines.zh: : 需要我提醒你别往歪处想吗？还是说你已经学会怎么守规矩了？

lines.en: : Don’t worry. {i}I’ve learned.{/i}
lines.zh: : 别担心。{i}我学乖了{/i}。

lines.en: : I understand it’s probably a...weird and difficult time for you, Miss Nakayama-
lines.zh: : 我知道现在对你来说大概是个……又奇怪又难熬的时期，Nakayama 小姐——

lines.en: scene nikimeetup14
: Please, call me Mrs. Arakawa instead.
lines.zh: : 请叫我 Arakawa 太太吧。

lines.en: : I thought you said you weren’t going to marry Onii-chan.
lines.zh: : 你不是说你不打算嫁给哥哥吗？

lines.en: : I thought you were going to jump off of a building. Proceed, blue-haired girl who I will soon win over.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你要跳楼呢。继续说吧，蓝头发的女孩，我很快就会把你拿下的。

lines.en: : I...was just saying...I know things are tough for you right now...so it shouldn’t go unsaid how appreciative we all are that you’d show up here. A ton of us have been wanting to meet you for a...while now.
lines.zh: : 我……只是想说……我知道你现在日子不好过……所以有些话还是该说出来——你能来这里，我们大家都非常感激。我们当中有好多人……已经想见你很久了。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup15
: Yeah, but the one who wants to meet her most just happens to be MIA.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可最想见她的那个人偏偏现在下落不明。

lines.en: : Uhh...I wouldn’t be so sure about that...
lines.zh: : 呃……这可不好说……

lines.en: scene nikimeetup16
: Hey, guys. Sorry I’ve been so weird all day.
lines.zh: : 大家好。抱歉，我今天一整天都怪怪的。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup17
: I had some tea with my sister and her friend to help calm me down and I think I’m finally ready to-
lines.zh: : 我跟我姐姐和她朋友喝了点茶，好让自己冷静下来，我想我终于准备好——

lines.en: scene nikimeetup18
: {size=-2}OH MY FUCKING GOD, MY QUEEN HAS RETURNED! AND SHE LOOKS EVEN MORE RADIANT THAN SHE WAS THE LAST TIME I SAW HER!!!! THANK YOU FOR GRACING US WITH YOUR PRESENCE! WE ARE NOT WORTHY!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}我操，我的女王回来了！而且她看起来比我上次见到她时还要光彩照人！！！！感谢您大驾光临！我们不配！{/size}

lines.en: : Oh. So you {i}can{/i} speak after all.
lines.zh: : 哦。这么说你{i}还是会{/i}说话的嘛。

lines.en: : {size=-2}I BOUGHT EVERYTHING I COULD FIND OF YOURS IN THE MALL! INCLUDING ONE BOX SET I HAD TO BRIBE A LITTLE KID FOR! SHE CRIED, BUT I REGRET NOTHING! MY LIFE IS YOURS TO TAKE! I LOVE YOU!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}我在商场里把你所有的周边都买下来了！包括一套盒装，我还得贿赂一个小孩才拿到！她哭了，但我一点都不后悔！我的命就是你的！我爱你！{/size}

lines.en: : So, in the industry, we have a special for word for fans like Chika.
lines.zh: : 在我们这行，对 Chika 这样的粉丝有个专门的词。

lines.en: : Is the word “insane?”
lines.zh: : 那个词是「疯子」吗？

lines.en: : It is actually, yeah.
lines.zh: : 还真是。

lines.en: : That’s very sweet of you, Chika. I can sign it for you if you bring it to me, you know.
lines.zh: : 你真是太贴心了，Chika。你要是拿来给我，我可以给你签名哦。

lines.en: : JUST CARVE YOUR NAME INTO MY WRISTS INSTEAD! DEEP ENOUGH THAT IT STAYS THERE FOREVER!
lines.zh: : 那就干脆把您的名字刻在我手腕上吧！刻得深一点，让它永远留在那儿！

lines.en: : Uhhh...{i}no.{/i} That, I will not do.
lines.zh: : 呃……{i}不行。{/i}这个我不会做。

lines.en: : Give the girl some space, please. Security would have had you in a chokehold by now.
lines.zh: : 请给这位姑娘一点空间好吗。换成保安，这会儿早把你按住了。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup19
: GIRL?! YOU DARE TO CALL {i}THE{/i} NIKI NAKAYAMA A MERE {i}GIRL?!{/i} I SHOULD PULL EVERY VEIN FROM YOUR BODY AND STRANGLE YOU WITH THEM, YOU FUCKING BITCH!
lines.zh: : 姑娘？！你竟敢把 {i}Niki Nakayama{/i} 叫做区区一个{i}姑娘{/i}？！我该把你身上每根血管都抽出来，用它们勒死你，你这个臭婊子！

lines.en: : Haven’t you been calling her “Girl” all day long? It’s been like the only word you can say.
lines.zh: : 你不是一整天都在叫她「姑娘」吗？那好像是你唯一会说的词了。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup20

: {size=-2}LIES! I CAN SAY ALL KINDS OF WORDS! BUFFALO! WINGDINGS! SEE?! JUST GIVE ME A WORD AND I’LL SAY IT! GIVE ME TEN WORDS! A HUNDRED! I’LL WRITE YOU AN ESSAY! PLEASE CALL ME CUTE AGAIN! PLEASE!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}谎言！我什么词都会说！水牛！Wingdings！看见没？！你给我一个词我就说！给我十个！一百个！我还能给你写一篇作文！请再叫我一次可爱吧！求你了！{/size}

lines.en: scene nikimeetup21
: Okay, new plan. Everybody out except for Chika and me. I need to have a talk with her in private.
lines.zh: : 好了，新计划。除了 Chika 和我，所有人出去。我得单独跟她谈谈。

lines.en: : PRIVATE?! DID YOU BRING A COSTUME?! ARE YOU PERFORMING FOR ME?! BECAUSE YOU DON’T HAVE TO! I’LL LOVE YOU NO MATTER WHAT! PLEASE DO IT, THOUGH! I’LL DIE! BUT IN A GOOD WAY!
lines.zh: : 单独？！您带演出服了吗？！您是要为我表演吗？！因为您不用特意的！不管怎么样我都爱您！不过还是请表演吧！我会死的！但是爽死的！

lines.en: : You sure about this, Niki? You don’t want someone to stick around and, like...make sure she doesn’t kill you or anything?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗，Niki？你不想留个人下来，比如……确保她不会杀了你什么的？

lines.en: scene nikimeetup22
: Aww, are you worried about me?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你是在担心我吗？

lines.en: : Yes. And I am not exactly trying to hide that. Chika is literally insane right now. And you picked probably the worst time in her life to appear before her.
lines.zh: : 是啊。而且我也没打算掩饰。Chika 现在是真的疯了。而你挑的出场时机，大概是她这辈子最糟的时候。

lines.en: : LIES! THERE’S NEVER BEEN A BETTER TIME THAN THIS! I’M MORE ALERT THAN I’VE EVER BEEN BEFORE! MY WHOLE LIFE HAS BEEN A PUSH TOWARD THIS EXACT MOMENT! I’M FINALLY FREE!
lines.zh: : 谎言！没有比现在更好的时机了！我从没像现在这样清醒过！我这一生都是在朝此刻推进！我终于自由了！

lines.en: : I’ve got this, Otoha. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 我来搞定，Otoha。别担心。

lines.en: : Could you at least keep Akira around? It might be easier getting through to her if-
lines.zh: : 至少把 Akira 留下行吗？有他在，说不定更容易说通她——

lines.en: : I already tried talking to her with him around and it didn’t help at all. Besides, I don’t think I’d be able to say all I want to say with him in the room.
lines.zh: : 我试过有他在的时候跟她谈，一点用都没有。而且，他在场的话，我想说的话大概一句都说不出口。

lines.en: : Could {i}you{/i} keep an eye on him, though? Without kissing him preferably.
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}能帮我看着他吗？最好别亲他。

lines.en: : That would be like kissing my brother.
lines.zh: : 那跟亲我哥哥没两样。

lines.en: : That’s the best part.
lines.zh: : 那才是最棒的地方。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup23
: Yup. I’m leaving. Don’t die, please.
lines.zh: : 好。我走了。别死了，拜托。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t plan on it.
lines.zh: : 我没打算死。

lines.en: scene black
: NDA lady! Take your students and- hey, where’d she go?
lines.zh: : 保密协议大姐！带你学生——咦，她上哪儿去了？

lines.en: : Miss Imai stepped out a second or two after Chika showed up. Presumably to call the police and report an imminent threat of some sort.
lines.zh: : Chika 一出现，Imai 老师过了一两秒就出去了。大概是去报警，说有什么迫在眉睫的威胁吧。

lines.en: : Chika ain’t gonna do shit. She’s just high on...{i}girl{/i} or whatever happens to you fucking lesbians.
lines.zh: : Chika 不会怎么样的。她只是嗨了……被{i}女人{/i}什么的冲昏头了，随你们这些该死的女同性恋是怎么个情况。

lines.en: : Why would you say that in response to me? I’m one of the few people in this class who isn’t attracted to girls.
lines.zh: : 你干嘛拿这话回我？我可是这个班里少数几个对女孩子没兴趣的人之一。

lines.en: : Oh, my bad. I just kind of assume you’re all gay until proven otherwise.
lines.zh: : 哦，我的错。我就是默认你们全都是同性恋，除非有人证明不是。

lines.en: : How...do I prove that?
lines.zh: : 那要怎么……证明？

lines.en: : Who’s the next one in charge then?! Someone needs to get these girls out of here!
lines.zh: : 那下一个负责人是谁？！得有人把这些姑娘弄出去！

lines.en: : I think that’d be me. But you told me not to speak to you, so-
lines.zh: : 我想是我吧。可您让我没开口就不许说话，所以——

lines.en: : This is obviously an exception! Get them out of here so I can talk to a {i}third{/i} girl alone tonight!
lines.zh: : 这显然是个例外！把她们弄出去，我今晚还得单独跟{i}第三{/i}个女孩谈谈！

lines.en: : My point’s not at risk, is it?! Because I know I said I didn’t want it earlier, but I kind of do now!
lines.zh: : 我的分不会受影响吧？！因为我知道我刚才说不要，但我现在有点想要了！

lines.en: : It’s the same point either way...you’re on the same floor.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样分都一样……你们在同一层楼。

lines.en: : Ah! Guys! Io finally spoke to me! Did anyone else- gah!
lines.zh: : 啊！大家！Io 终于跟我说话了！有没有人也——啊！

lines.en: : Come on, Rin.
lines.zh: : 走吧，Rin。

lines.en: : Let’s leave the two of them alone for now...
lines.zh: : 我们暂时让她们俩单独待着吧……

lines.en: scene nikimeetup24
: I can’t believe it...I’m alone in a room with {i}Niki!{/i} Do you have any idea how many times I’ve dreamed about this exact thing?! Because I don’t! I’ve lost count!
lines.zh: : 我简直不敢相信……我和 {i}Niki{/i} 单独待在一个房间里了！你知道我梦到过多少次这个场景吗？！因为我不知道！我数不清了！

lines.en: : Just take however many dreams I’ve had and multiply it by four! That seems only fair since there’s more than one of you sometimes! I can’t believe this is actually happening!
lines.zh: : 就把我做过的梦乘以四好了！这很公平吧，因为有时候「你」还不止一个！我真不敢相信这是真的！

lines.en: : So you’re really one of my biggest fans, huh?
lines.zh: : 所以你真的是我最铁的粉丝之一咯？

lines.en: : ONE OF?! I am THE biggest fan! I live, breathe, and {i}SLEEP{/i} Niki. I would do ANYTHING for you! Just name it! Please! Let me be of use!
lines.zh: : 之一？！我是最铁的那个！我活着、呼吸着、{i}睡觉{/i}都是 Niki。我愿意为你做任何事！你说吧！求你了！让我派上点用场！

lines.en: : And if nothing I can {i}do{/i} is of use, I give you FULL permission to use me however you want! I can handle pain! I {i}like{/i} pain! I WILL GLADLY BE YOUR PUNCHING BAG.
lines.zh: : 如果我{i}做{/i}什么都没用，那我完全允许你随便怎么用我都行！我受得住疼！我{i}喜欢{/i}疼！我心甘情愿当你的沙包。

lines.en: : I want you to stop fucking my boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 我要你别再跟我男朋友上床了。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup25
: Don’t play dumb with me. I’ve been watching him my whole life. I know his tells and I picked up on it the second he looked at you.
lines.zh: : 别跟我装傻。我盯着他看了一辈子了。他那些小动作我了如指掌，他看你那一眼我就全明白了。

lines.en: : In the past, I’d have just ignored something like that. But things are different now. And I’m not about to let some random teenager steal my thunder {i}and{/i} my man while pretending to be my biggest fan.
lines.zh: : 换在过去，这种事我大概就睁一只眼闭一只眼了。但现在不一样了。我也绝不会让一个来路不明的女高中生，一边装成我最铁的粉丝，一边偷走我的风头{i}和{/i}我的男人。

lines.en: : So if you really love me, you’ll fuck off and leave him alone. Do that and I’ll sign anything you want for the rest of forever.
lines.zh: : 所以如果你真的爱我，就滚远点，别再缠着他。做到的话，你想要什么我就给你签什么，签一辈子。

lines.en: : Hell, I’ll even give you a lock of my hair to sniff before you go to sleep or something. People like you want things like that, right?
lines.zh: : 妈的，我甚至能给你一绺我的头发，让你睡觉前闻什么的。你们这种人不就好这口吗？

lines.en: : People...like me?
lines.zh: : 我们……这种人？

lines.en: : Obsessive. Creepy.
lines.zh: : 病态。变态。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup26
: {i}C...Creepy?...{/i}
: Don’t get me wrong. I’m flattered. And I’m sure you love my music just as much as you love me.
lines.zh: : 别误会。我很受用。而且我相信你爱我的音乐，就跟爱我一样多。

lines.en: : But if you can’t figure out how to turn it down, can you really say you’re my biggest fan of all? Aren’t you being, like, super inconsiderate of my feelings and comfort right now?
lines.zh: : 可你要是连收敛点都做不到，还好意思说自己是头号粉丝吗？你现在这样，是不是超级不顾我的感受、不顾我舒不舒服？

lines.en: : I...I’m sorry...I wasn’t trying to...be weird...I just...
lines.zh: : 我……对不起……我不是故意要……这么奇怪的……我只是……

lines.en: scene nikimeetup27

: It’s fine. I’m more or less used to it by now. I’ve done plenty of meet and greets in the past, though. And I’m normally really good with faces, but I don’t seem to remember yours. This really is your first time, huh?
lines.zh: : 没关系。我差不多已经习惯了。我以前办过不少见面会。而且我通常很记脸，可我好像不记得你这张脸。这真的是你第一次来，对吧？

lines.en: : I...I haven’t ever had much money and-
lines.zh: : 我……我一直都没什么钱，而且——

lines.en: : You haven’t ever had much money and somehow went out of your way to buy out everything you could find of mine at the mall? Isn’t that, like...really irresponsible?
lines.zh: : 你一直没什么钱，却还特意跑去商场把能找到的我的东西全买光了？这难道不是……很不负责任吗？

lines.en: scene nikimeetup28
: I...I have it {i}now!{/i} I got a new job! At the same maid cafe you did a promotional event at back when-
lines.zh: : 我……我{i}现在{/i}有钱了！我找了份新工作！就在你以前办过宣传活动的那家女仆咖啡厅——

lines.en: : Save it. I don’t need to hear your story. Just let me know if you’ll do what I say and I can get back to becoming acquainted with the rest of your class.
lines.zh: : 省省吧。我不需要听你的故事。你只要告诉我你听不听我的，我好回去继续认识你们班其他人。

lines.en: : Fine! I’ll do it! I’ll stop seeing him! There’s somebody else I like anyway! You just helped make up my mind for me!
lines.zh: : 好！我听！我不见他就是了！反正我还有别的喜欢的人！你刚好帮我下定了决心！

lines.en: scene nikimeetup29
: OH, GET A FUCKING GRIP, YOU IDIOT! WHAT KIND OF HALF-HEARTED, WEAK-WILLED EXCUSE FOR A GIRL GIVES UP ON HER LOVE THAT EASILY?!
lines.zh: : 给我他妈的振作点，白痴！三心二意、意志薄弱成这样的女的，哪有那么容易就放弃自己的爱情？！

lines.en: : {size=-4}HAVE YOU LEARNED NOTHING FROM MY MUSIC?! ARE YOU EVEN LISTENING?! DO YOU REALLY THINK I’D BE WHERE I AM TODAY IF I WAS AS FUCKING PATHETIC AS YOU?! FUCK NO! I’M HERE BECAUSE I TRIED! BECAUSE I GAVE A SHIT!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-4}我的音乐你他妈一点都没听进去吗？！你到底有没有在听？！你真觉得我要是像你这么可悲，能有今天？！他妈的当然不可能！我能有今天，是因为我努力过！因为我在乎过！{/size}

lines.en: scene nikimeetup30

: And right now, there is another girl right down the hall, ready to take a leap of faith and risk breaking her pathetic little heart for something you already {i}have,{/i} but are now itching to give away.
lines.zh: : 而现在，走廊那头还有一个女孩，正准备孤注一掷，为了一样你已经{i}拥有{/i}、却正急着甩掉的东西，冒着自己那颗可悲的小心脏碎掉的风险。

lines.en: : Is this really what you want to be? {i}Who{/i} you want to be? Someone who lets a person you only know through a fucking screen tell you what to do and how to think? I’m not your fucking {i}god.{/i} I am an idol.
lines.zh: : 这真的是你想成为的样子吗？就当一个任由一个你只在屏幕上见过的人告诉你该做什么、该怎么想的人？我不是你他妈的{i}神{/i}。我是个偶像。

lines.en: : Does the me you’ve manufactured speak like this? Does she yell at her fans? Is she getting raw-dogged by a massive dick every night after drowning her sorrows in alcohol? No!
lines.zh: : 你脑子里捏出来的那个我，会这么说话吗？会冲自己的粉丝吼吗？会在每晚用酒精灌醉自己的悲伤之后，被一根巨大的鸡巴无套干吗？不会！

lines.en: : Because you don’t {i}know{/i} me. You just {i}think{/i} you do.
lines.zh: : 因为你根本不{i}了解{/i}我。你只是{i}以为{/i}你了解。

lines.en: : {size=-4}And you’ve fallen so deep into that pit of blind ideology that you’re now little more than another face in a crowd of millions with your mouth open and your tongue out, trying to catch {i}my{/i} sweat and {i}my{/i} tears on your tongue like they’re fucking snowflakes.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-4}而你在那口盲目崇拜的井里陷得这么深，如今不过是芸芸众生中的又一张脸——张着嘴、伸着舌头，想接住我的汗和我的泪，就好像它们是他妈的雪花一样。{/size}

lines.en: : I...I don’t understand what you want...I can’t tell what you...want me to do...
lines.zh: : 我……我不明白你想要什么……我不知道你……想让我做什么……

lines.en: : Well then join the fucking club because I don’t know either anymore. I just know that seeing you throw away something so {i}big{/i} just because I told you to pisses me the fuck off.
lines.zh: : 那你就他妈的排队吧，因为我现在也不知道。我只知道，看到你因为我一句话就把这么{i}重要{/i}的东西扔掉，简直把我气炸了。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup31
: Now, be honest. Do you love him or not?
lines.zh: : 现在，说实话。你到底爱不爱他？

lines.en: : Does that even make a difference?...
lines.zh: : 这有什么区别吗？……

lines.en: scene nikimeetup32
: Because if...if you two are really childhood friends...and I have to compete against {i}you?{/i} What the fucking...{i}fuck{/i} am I supposed to do about that? Huh?!
lines.zh: : 因为如果……如果你们俩真的是青梅竹马……那我还得跟{i}你{/i}抢？这他妈的……我{i}他妈{/i}该怎么办啊？啊？！

lines.en: : I can’t {i}win!{/i} You said it yourself! I’m just some random teenager!
lines.zh: : 我{i}赢不了{/i}！你自己说的！我只是个来路不明的女高中生！

lines.en: : And that’s all you’ll ever be unless you man the fuck up and do something about it.
lines.zh: : 你要是不他妈的振作起来做点什么，那你永远就只是这样了。

lines.en: : So you {i}want{/i} me to keep fucking him then? And this is some kind of...weird, motivational speech that I’m just too dumb to understand?
lines.zh: : 所以你是{i}想{/i}让我继续跟他上床？这算是某种……我太笨听不懂的励志演讲？

lines.en: : {size=-4}It’s a wake-up call. I could not give less of a shit about your motivations. And if I found out tomorrow that you moved away and cut all ties with Akira, I would jump for joy at culling even one member of your obnoxious hormonal herd.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-4}这是当头棒喝。你动机是什么我一点都不在乎。就算明天我听说你搬走了、跟 Akira 断得一干二净，我也会因为你们这群荷尔蒙过剩的讨厌鬼少了一个而高兴得跳起来。{/size}

lines.en: scene nikimeetup33
: I really do love you...Niki...
lines.zh: : 我真的好爱你……Niki……

lines.en: : Like, you don’t understand. Your music...your face...it’s all gotten me through so much and...and even if that’s all by design, was it or was it not designed to help girls like me?!
lines.zh: : 你不懂。你的音乐……你的脸……它们陪我熬过了那么多事，而且……而且就算那全都是设计好的，它当初难道不就是为了帮像我这样的女孩子吗？！

lines.en: : I’m not some bandwagon fangirl! I scribble your lyrics in my notebooks at school! I’ve even been thinking about getting some of them tattooed on me once I’m old enough to...That’s how serious I am about you.
lines.zh: : 我不是什么跟风粉！我在学校的笔记本上涂满你的歌词！我甚至在想，等我到了年纪就把其中几句纹在身上……我对你是认真到这个地步的。

lines.en: : And still, you stand there and say things like “my notebook at school” or “when I’m old enough” with complete disregard for how that makes {i}me{/i} feel.
lines.zh: : 可你还是站在那儿，说什么「我学校的笔记本」、什么「等我到了年纪」，完全不顾{i}我{/i}听了是什么感受。

lines.en: : The boy I have loved for longer than you have been alive has been sleeping with someone like you for God knows how long. And you think {i}you’re{/i} the insignificant one here?
lines.zh: : 我爱上的那个男孩，我爱他的时间比你活在这世上的年头还长，而他跟一个像你这样的人上床已经不知道多久了。{i}你{/i}倒觉得自己才是那个无足轻重的人？

lines.en: : I...I don’t know what to...
lines.zh: : 我……我不知道该……

lines.en: : Telling you to stop was supposed to snap you the fuck out of this fucking nonsense. Not get you to cave immediately.
lines.zh: : 我叫你停手，本来是想把你从这堆狗屁里他妈的震醒，不是让你立刻就服软。

lines.en: : You had a chance to impress me and you fucking blew it, Chika. You’re no different from anyone else who jots my lyrics down in a notebook without actually {i}thinking{/i} about them.
lines.zh: : 你本来有机会让我刮目相看，结果被你他妈的搞砸了，Chika。你跟那些把我的歌词抄在笔记本上、却根本不动脑子{i}想{/i}的人没什么两样。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup34
: I {i}am,{/i} though! You don’t understand!
lines.zh: : 我{i}才不是{/i}！你不明白！

lines.en: : Then fucking prove it and fucking {i}make{/i} me!
lines.zh: : 那就他妈的证明给我看，{i}逼{/i}我相信啊！

lines.en: : I don’t know how! Everything’s been so fucking confusing lately! And I thought this was going to be the moment to turn it all around, but apparently {i}that{/i} was wrong too!
lines.zh: : 我不知道怎么做！最近一切都他妈的乱成一团！我还以为这一刻就是转机，结果显然连{i}这个{/i}也错了！

lines.en: : You don’t know that yet! You don’t fucking know that!
lines.zh: : 你还不知道呢！你他妈的什么都还不知道！

lines.en: scene nikimeetup35
: Because it very well {i}could{/i} be...
lines.zh: : 因为它很{i}可能{/i}就是……

lines.en: : And part of me {i}wants{/i} it to be because, when I look at pieces of shit like you desperately trying to keep it together, it reminds me of myself when I was your age.
lines.zh: : 而我心里有一部分{i}希望{/i}它是，因为当我看着像你这样拼命想把一切拼起来的小屁孩，我就想起了你这个年纪的我自己。

lines.en: : None of this would have ever happened if Akira didn’t run away from me. Him shattering my heart into a million pieces gave me the spite and the fuel I needed to rebuild myself from the ground up.
lines.zh: : 如果 Akira 当初没有从我身边逃走，这一切都不会发生。他把我的心摔成了一百万片，那给了我怨恨，也给了我燃料，让我得以从零开始重建自己。

lines.en: : And while I can’t imagine this will do even half the damage to you that Akira did to me, I hope it does something.
lines.zh: : 虽然我不觉得这能给你造成 Akira 对我造成的哪怕一半的伤害，但我希望它至少能起点作用。

lines.en: : This world needs more idols. More people to lift the spirits of others when there is so much pain everywhere we look. So do {i}that{/i} for me if anything. {i}That’s{/i} how you can make me happy.
lines.zh: : 这个世界需要更多偶像。需要更多在举目皆痛的时候，能把别人的精神撑起来的人。所以如果实在没什么别的，就为我做{i}这个{/i}吧。{i}这{/i}是你唯一能让我开心的方式。

lines.en: : But...But Sensei...
lines.zh: : 可是……可是 Sensei……

lines.en: scene nikimeetup36

: Oh, fuck that guy! This isn’t about him anymore! If he wants to have sex with you, he’s going to have sex with you whether either one of us wants him to or not! That’s just how it works and I fucking hate it!
lines.zh: : 哦，去他的！这事跟他没关系了！他想跟你上床，那他就一定会跟你上床，不管我们俩谁愿不愿意！事情就是这么运作的，我他妈恨死了！

lines.en: : But...I...I don’t want to hurt you...any more than you’ve already {i}been{/i} hurt.
lines.zh: : 可是……我……我不想伤害你……你受的伤{i}已经{/i}够多了。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup37
: Chika, I can guarantee you that nothing {i}you{/i} do is going to hurt me. You’re just another bump in the road as far as I’m concerned.
lines.zh: : Chika，我向你保证，你做什么都伤不到我。对我{i}来{/i}说，你不过是路上的又一个坎。

lines.en: : Do I want you to have less sex with my boyfriend? Yes. {i}Obviously.{/i} But a want is just a want unless you make it happen. And despite what you might believe, I can’t tell you what to do.
lines.zh: : 我想让你少跟我男朋友上床吗？想。{i}废话{/i}。可愿望如果只是愿望，那就什么都不是，除非你让它成真。而且不管你怎么想，我没资格指挥你。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup38
: Now what? If you’re waiting for me to give you a handkerchief or something, it’s not going to happen.
lines.zh: : 又怎么了？你要是等着我递手帕什么的，那是不可能的事。

lines.en: : It’s stupid...don’t worry about it...
lines.zh: : 很蠢的……别管了……

lines.en: : I just...really fucked this up...is all...
lines.zh: : 我只是……真的把这件事搞砸了……而已……

lines.en: scene nikimeetup39
: It’s kind of...funny, actually...heheh...
lines.zh: : 其实……有点好笑……呵呵……

lines.en: : I’ve, like...practiced for this moment.
lines.zh: : 我……为这一刻练习过的。

lines.en: : I had it all planned out...every single question and statement. The things I’d say to clearly get it across to you just how...monumental you’ve been in my development.
lines.zh: : 我全都计划好了……每一个问题、每一句话。我要说些什么，才能清楚地让你明白，你在我成长的过程中有多么……举足轻重。

lines.en: : I can’t remember any of it...
lines.zh: : 可我现在一句都想不起来了……

lines.en: : Not a single word...
lines.zh: : 一个字都想不起来……

lines.en: : I practiced so many times...
lines.zh: : 我练了那么多次……

lines.en: : Well, you can take solace in knowing this won’t be the last time you see me. So maybe you’ll figure it out one day.
lines.zh: : 你可以放心，这不会是你最后一次见到我。所以也许有一天你能想起来。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup40
: You mean I’ll...see you again?
lines.zh: : 你是说……我还能再见到你？

lines.en: : My days as the Niki of your dreams are numbered. And I’m going to be more present in Akira’s life from now on so, chances are, we’ll be bumping into each other every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 我做你梦中那个 Niki 的日子已经不多了。而且从现在起，我会更多地出现在 Akira 的生活里，所以我们大概时不时就会碰上面。

lines.en: : I’m not sure...how to face you when that happens...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……到那时候该怎么面对你……

lines.en: : I feel like I fucked everything up today.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我今天把一切都搞砸了。

lines.en: : Could’ve been worse. At least you didn’t fuck him in front of me.
lines.zh: : 本来可能更糟的。至少你没当着我的面跟他做。

lines.en: : I would never.
lines.zh: : 我永远不会。

lines.en: : Good.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: : Unless you asked me to.
lines.zh: : 除非你让我这么做。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup41
: Out.
lines.zh: : 出去。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m going.
lines.zh: : 是，我走。

lines.en: scene nikimeetup42
: One last thing, though...
lines.zh: : 不过还有最后一件事……

lines.en: : Make it quick. I’ve been on my feet all day and I’d very much like to go drown myself in the bath.
lines.zh: : 长话短说。我站了一整天了，现在非常想去浴缸里把自己淹死。

lines.en: : I’m going to follow my heart...like you said.
lines.zh: : 我会跟着自己的心走……就像你说的那样。

lines.en: : And I still don’t think I have a chance to beat you, but...I’m going to give it my all.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得自己没机会赢过你，但是……我会全力以赴的。

lines.en: : So what you’re telling me is you’re going to keep fucking my boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 所以你是在告诉我，你打算继续跟我男朋友上床。
